BiblicalUsage: Ridicule is what Jerusalem became: guilty in her blood and defiled in her idols, she was made a reproach to the heathen and a mocking to all countries.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mocking was the public face of the judgment, and a city that scorned God became scorned herself.
